entries.resultText: The working fizzles. The rite fails without further harm, but the materials are spoiled.
entries.resultNotes: No spell effect. Replace consumable ritual materials.

entries.resultText: The power slips sideways. A harmless but unsettling omen appears nearby.
entries.resultNotes: GM adds a brief manifestation, sign, or sensory disturbance.

entries.resultText: The caster is left spiritually winded and suffers a moment of weakness.
entries.resultNotes: Apply a short-lived weakness or narrative fatigue.

entries.resultText: The rite lingers imperfectly. The spell cannot be attempted again until the next dawn.
entries.resultNotes: Temporary lockout on this spell.

entries.resultText: The sign is misread. The next omen or divinatory answer concerning the same matter is clouded.
entries.resultNotes: Penalty is narrative unless later system support is added.

entries.resultText: The caster draws attention. Nearby spirits, hidden folk, or watching powers become faintly aware of the rite.
entries.resultNotes: Use as a future complication hook.

entries.resultText: The working rebounds softly. A minor inconvenience or ill-luck clings to the caster for the scene.
entries.resultNotes: Suitable for mild curse flavor.

entries.resultText: The spell half-forms and stains its tools. The ritual focus or vessel gains an obvious occult tell.
entries.resultNotes: Best used for item-focused workings.

entries.resultText: The caster is struck by backlash and suffers a real weakening of body or spirit.
entries.resultNotes: Apply Weakened, a stat loss, or comparable short-term debility.

entries.resultText: The spell fastens to the wrong target: the caster, a helper, or a sympathetic object nearby.
entries.resultNotes: Redirect success effect or a softened version of it.

entries.resultText: An intrusive presence answers the rite. Something unseen now watches, follows, or remembers the caster.
entries.resultNotes: Strong future complication.

entries.resultText: The rite leaves a stain in place. Threshold, room, grave, or vessel becomes spiritually troubled.
entries.resultNotes: Use for local haunting, ill feeling, or ritual instability.

entries.resultText: The caster is marked by the failure. A visible or divinatory tell reveals recent occult misuse.
entries.resultNotes: Could become a trait or discoverable sign.

entries.resultText: The spell opens too far. A hostile omen, false message, or deceptive sign replaces the intended result.
entries.resultNotes: Especially appropriate for divination and prophecy.

entries.resultText: The materials turn against the rite. A vessel breaks, wax collapses, cord knots itself, or ink blackens the hand.
entries.resultNotes: Narrative item damage and failed rite.

entries.resultText: The working binds strain to the caster. Until properly cleansed, later rites of the same school are harder to perform.
entries.resultNotes: Track as temporary magical strain.

entries.resultText: The power breaks loose completely. A hostile force, entity, or effect manifests beyond the caster's control.
entries.resultNotes: Best for grimoire, summoning, pact, and necromancy disasters.

entries.resultText: The spell inverts. The intended blessing becomes a curse, the ward becomes an opening, or the binding becomes a release.
entries.resultNotes: Reverse the spell's broad intent.

entries.resultText: The caster is spiritually torn. A lasting curse, mark, or pact-strain is inflicted.
entries.resultNotes: Good place to create a Supernatural Mark later.

entries.resultText: The ritual contaminates the place. Ground, room, vessel, or threshold becomes dangerous until ritually repaired.
entries.resultNotes: Strong area complication.

entries.resultText: Something is lost in the crossing. Memory, voice, warmth, shadow, or name is partially taken from the caster.
entries.resultNotes: Use as a severe narrative cost or direct stat/trait loss.

entries.resultText: The caster is seized by backlash and collapses under body-and-soul strain.
entries.resultNotes: Could cause unconsciousness, wounds, or a scene-ending breakdown.

entries.resultText: The spell binds itself into the wrong thing permanently: a tool, corpse, vessel, home, or living bystander.
entries.resultNotes: Creates a new problem creature, cursed item, or haunted place.

entries.resultText: The failure tears open a path that should have remained shut. The world is left thinner, stranger, and easier for later horrors to breach.
entries.resultNotes: Best for Zone, Unnatural, and Unseen complications.
